title: Protocol to use RNaseH1-based CRISPR to modulate locus-associated R-loops
protocol: Culture TRExTM-293 cells in complete medium consisting of DMEM supplemented with tetracycline-free FBS and penicillin-streptomycin at 37°C and 5% CO2 in 100 mm tissue culture plates.
Passage the cells when they reach 80%-90% confluency by removing the culture medium.
Wash the cells once with pre-warmed (37°C) 1× PBS.
Add 1 mL of 0.025% (w/v) 1× trypsin-EDTA at 37°C and wait for 1 min to allow cellular dissociation from the cell culture plate.
Add 9 mL of pre-warmed complete medium to stop the reaction.
Pipette well to suspend the cells.
Transfer 2 mL of the cell suspension to a new 100 mm tissue culture plate containing 8 mL of fresh pre-warmed complete medium.
Count the cells using a hemocytometer after mixing a 20 μL aliquot of cell suspension with Trypan blue in a 1:1 ratio.
Seed 2.0 × 10^6 cells per 60 mm tissue culture plate containing pre-warmed and fresh complete medium to achieve approximately 70% confluence.
Place the seeded plates at 37°C and 5% CO2 for overnight incubation prior to transfection.
Prepare Tet+ complete medium by adding 10 μL of the 1 mg/mL tetracycline stock solution to 10 mL of pre-warmed complete medium in a 50 mL conical tube.
Change the media for the cells by replacing it with Tet+ media.
Mix Tube A (containing Lipofectamine 3000 and Opti-Mem) with Tube B (containing Plasmid DNA, P3000, and Opti-Mem) to form mixture A.
Incubate mixture A for 15 minutes at 21°C–25°C.
Mix Tube A (containing RNAiMAX and Opti-Mem) with Tube B (containing sgRNAs and Opti-Mem) to form mixture B.
Incubate mixture B for 5 minutes at 21°C–25°C.
Add both Mix A and Mix B to the cells.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down to create mix A.
Incubate for 15 min at 21°C–25°C.
Add 500 μL of the combined mixture to cells dropwise.
Prepare the sgRNA transfection mix by combining specified volumes.
Combine Lipofectamine RNAiMAX with specified volumes.
Include a non-targeting sgRNA control.
Incubate Tube A for 1 min at 21°C–25°C.
Add 1.5 μL of each sgRNA to Tube B if using a pool of sgRNAs.
Adjust the volume of non-targeting sgRNA control to match the total volume of sgRNAs in the pool.
Add 375 μL of Tube A to each sgRNA mix tube (Tube B) to create Mix B.
Incubate Mix B for 5 min at 21°C–25°C.
Gradually drip 750 μL of combined mix onto cells.
Incubate cells for 36 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Digest genomic DNA with a cocktail of restriction enzymes.
Confirm digestion using agarose gel electrophoresis.
Purify input DNA and DNA from IPs using a commercially available Gel/PCR DNA Fragment Extraction Kit.
Use purified DNA in qPCR.
Include qPCR primers for both the targeted locus (i.e., IGS28) and the R-loop-containing locus modulated in trans (i.e., IGS18).
Include qPCR primers that generate PCR amplicons within the vicinity of the sgRNA sites.
Remove the cell culture medium and wash cells twice with 5 mL of ice-cold 1× PBS.
Wash cells three times if the culture medium contains toxic drugs.
Add 5 mL 1× PBS to each plate.
Gently scrape the cells into a 15 mL conical tube.
Pellet the cells gently by centrifuging at 270 × g for 5 min at 21°C–25°C.
Resuspend the cells in 1.6 mL of TE.
Add 41.5 μL of 20% SDS and 5 μL of 20 mg/mL proteinase K to resuspend the cells.
Incubate with constant rotation for 15-18 h at 37°C.
Add 1.6 mL of phenol-chloroform to each tube under the fume hood while wearing PPE.
Gently invert the tube to mix.
Centrifuge the tube at 450 × g for 5 min at 21°C–25°C.
Carefully transfer the top aqueous layer (∼1.5 mL) to a new conical tube using a widened 1,000 μL micropipette tip.
Add 1.4 mL of phenol-chloroform and repeat major steps (mixing and centrifuging).
While samples are being centrifuged, add 80 μL of 3 M NaOAc pH 5.2 and 1,920 μL of 100% EtOH to a new 15 mL conical tube.
Transfer 800 μL of the aqueous phase from step to the prepared tube and gently mix by inverting until a 'whitish' fiber-like precipitate appears.
Spool the DNA fiber with a 100 μL micropipette tip and transfer it into a 1.5 mL tube.
Wash the DNA fiber five times each with 1,000 μL of 70% EtOH and gentle inverting of the tube to allow fibers to settle.
Carefully remove as much of the ethanol as possible after washing.
Dry the genomic DNA (gDNA) pellets for 2–3 h at 21°C–25°C.
Add 200 μL of TE to each tube containing dried gDNA.
Gently resuspend the gDNA pellet using a cut 200 μL micropipette tip.
Mix by pipetting up and down with a cut 200 μL micropipette tip.
Incubate with constant rotation for 15–18 hours at 37°C.
Run 9 μL of the digested DNA on a 1% agarose gel with Red Safe staining.
Run the gel at 125 V for 25 minutes at 21°C–25°C to confirm DNA digestion.
The resulting DNA sizes should appear as a smear peaking in intensity at ∼200–500 bp.
Add 40 μL of 3 M NaOAc pH 5.2 to the digested DNA.
Add 400 μL of phenol-chloroform and mix well.
Centrifuge at 16,100 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Transfer 300 μL of the top aqueous phase to a new tube.
Repeat steps 37–39.
Add 2.4 volumes (∼600 μL) of cold 100% EtOH.
Incubate for 15 min at −20°C to precipitate DNA.
Centrifuge at 16,100 × g for 30 min at 4°C to pellet the DNA.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of cold 70% EtOH.
Centrifuge at 16,100 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Air dry for 30 min under the fume hood.
Resuspend the pellet in 50 μL of TE.
Measure the concentration (OD260) of the DNA using NanoDrop2000 or similar method.
Add 4.4 μg of digested DNA for each IP to a new 1.5 mL low retention tube.
Top-up to a total of 100 μL with nuclease-free ddH2O.
Incubate 4.4 μg of digested DNA with 20 μL (100 U) of RNase H1, 10 μL of 10× RNase H1 buffer in a total volume of 100 μL for 15–18 h at 37°C as an anti-RNA-DNA hybrid specificity control.
Perform two independent IPs for each sample using the S9.6 antibody to pull down DNA-RNA hybrids or anti-IgG as mock pulldown control.
Add 350 μL of TE buffer and 50 μL of 10× binding buffer to each sample.
Set aside 50 μL of each sample to serve as input.
Add 10 μg of the S9.6 antibody to each IP tube.
For mock IP controls, add 10 μg of mouse anti-IgG antibody instead.
Rotate for 15-18 hours at 4°C.
Wash 50 μL of Dynabeads or similar three times with 1 mL of the 1× binding buffer by rotating for 10 minutes at 21°C–25°C.
Pellet beads on a DynaMagTM-2 Magnet rack or centrifuge, and remove the 1× binding buffer.
Add the antibody-DNA mix directly into the tubes prepared in step 54.
Rotate for 2 hours at 4°C.
Pellet the beads and discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads three times with 1 mL of the 1× binding buffer by rotating for 10 minutes at 21°C–25°C.
Resuspend the beads in 250 μL of DRIP elution buffer.
Add 200 μL of DRIP elution buffer to each input.
Add 7 μL of proteinase K to a final concentration of 0.5 mg/mL to each sample and mix well.
Incubate for 45 minutes at 55°C.
Pellet the beads in IP samples and transfer the eluate to a new low retention tube.
Purify DNA samples using Geneaid Gel/PCR DNA fragment extraction kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Run quantitative real-time PCR using SensiFast No-ROX SYBR according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Calculate the %Input/IgG for each sample by adjusting the input (%Input) = Log (Your dilution factor, 2).
Determine corrected Ct = 100 × 2^(Adjusted Input – Ct IP).
Present data relative to the negative background control (IgG): %Input/IgG = corrected Ct for IP/Corrected Ct for IgG.
